first.rationale: I currently intend to simplify onboarding because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields improved early adoption durably. I would verify both records before committing, then run a guarded test measuring completion, activation, qualified pipeline, and retention so gains in early conversion do not mask downstream-value deterioration.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding simplification experiment for simple accounts and SMBs, where prior evidence supports improved completion and activation. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased 60-day churn there. Measure onboarding completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and retention, with a guardrail against downstream churn. This addresses both current completion and activation declines without generalizing a risky intervention across segments.
